agentRunsBlock.title: Agent runs
agentRunsBlock.description: Project spend, model usage and session history in one connected view.
agentRunsBlock.compositionBody: Preserves the reference hierarchy: project totals, cost trend, agent activity lanes, agent/model distributions and daily session records. Uses native Zeron AreaChart, Grid, axes and TooltipContent, shared chart tokens, SegmentedBar, ChartLegend, Tabs, DataTable, Avatar and Badge. DataTable owns headers, records, date sections, spanning details and pagination. Activity bars use the same time domain as the chart; width represents duration, with a minimum visible mark for brief runs.
agentRunsBlock.dataContractBody: Pass a complete reporting window and its sessions, stable agent/model IDs, start/end timestamps in epoch milliseconds, currency and per-session input/output/cache-read/cache-write token counts and costs in major currency units. Every total and distribution derives from the same sessions. Cache hit is cache-read tokens divided by input plus cache-read tokens. Null usage remains unreported; cumulative cost is posted at session completion, or at the window end for reported active usage. Agent time sums session durations and can exceed elapsed wall time. No provider or pricing API is connected by this block. Sample model names and costs are illustrative. Nonzero charges below the currency minor unit retain up to four significant digits. Invalid locale and timeZone fall back independently to en-US and UTC.
agentRunsBlock.behaviorBody: Switch cumulative/per-run views, select an activity mark to locate and expand that session, browse daily grouped records with pagination, or inspect cost and cache details. The built-in pager supports page size, page summary, first/last and previous/next controls. Date headings and details do not consume session page slots. The host can control mode, handle onModeChange, onOpenSession and onClose, and provide loading/error/retry state. Change data.id to reset local state. Short-window axes show time (including seconds below one minute); multi-day windows show dates. Chart keyboard navigation and a raw cost data table provide nonvisual access. Narrow containers stack metrics and distributions, with horizontal scrolling confined to the session table and the time column, date headings and daily summaries pinned on the left. Expanded details also stay within the visible width and stack vertically on narrow screens. The bounded table content scrolls vertically beneath sticky column headers, with pagination outside the scrolling area. Page size, page summary and navigation buttons remain on one row on small screens. The demo includes ready, loading, empty and error states.
